pages.title: Odachi
pages.text: Odachi-type sword warriors. Sword warriors of the same type have basically no difference in attack speed, search range, attack power, and movement speed. Odachi can perform area-of-effect splash attacks.

pages.name: Ishikirimaru
pages.text: The sacred sword of Ishikirikenja Shrine. Having spent a long time at the shrine, he is not very knowledgeable about the outside world. More than its sharpness as a blade, it is expected to have powers such as healing swellings and curing diseases. He watches over everyone with gentle eyes.
